item.title: Poultry must be kept indoors in England and Scotland over bird flu risk
item.body: Poultry and captive birds in England and Scotland must be kept inside for the second year in a row because of an increased risk of a devastating strain of bird flu. The government has issued an England-wide avian influenza prevention zone.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🐓 Poultry must be kept indoors in England and Scotland over bird flu risk

Poultry and captive birds in England and Scotland must be kept inside for the second year in a row because of an increased risk of a devastating strain of bird flu. The government has issued an England-wide avian influenza prevention zone.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 11 November, 12:50
